::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/collect_payment"}
#docs
Settles open invoices in the business's order (`billing_rules_config.payment_application.invoice_order`; default oldest due first), credit on file before the card.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | Customer id (cus_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is optional.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | no | Money budget in minor units; requires currency |
| `currency` | `string` | no | ISO currency; required when amount_minor is set |
| `invoice_ids` | `array of string` | no | The ids of the invoices to collect (inv_…). |
| `payment_method_id` | `string` | no | Charge this payment method (pm_…) |
| `invoice_allocations` | `array of object` | no | Settle these invoices, in this order, each up to `allocation_amount` (credit + charge; default its whole remainder). Each must be an open invoice of this customer, all in one currency, and an amount may not exceed what the invoice owes; their total may not exceed `amount_minor`. Exclusive with `invoice_ids`. A card is charged only for an invoice's full remainder, so an allocation below what is left after credit applies credit only. |
| `invoice_allocations.invoice_id` | `string` | **yes** | The invoice's id (inv_…). |
| `invoice_allocations.allocation_amount` | `integer` | no | The amount to collect for this invoice, in minor units. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Collection result |
| `400` | Invalid body / currency required |
| `404` | No such customer |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/collect_payment" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "amount_minor": 2900,
    "currency": "USD"
  }'
```
